verdict.rationale: The official first-project guide explicitly covers creating a project and index, adding documents, and running a first search in the default web interface. Local install is a one-line cURL command for a single binary with no dependencies, plus Docker, Homebrew and APT options. Hands-on reports back this up: one user indexed and searched 15k documents with zero config within 30 minutes, and others describe server setup as easy and one-click Docker deploys as 'just worked'. One user said building index creation, uploads and settings changes into their own application took about a week of coding, which tempers the 'minutes' claim beyond the quickstart. Missing for 10: a documented time-to-first-search for the quickstart itself, and consistent independent evidence that the full create/add/search flow takes minutes (one report says app integration took about a week).
